tv/acer-tv-repair-service-in-coimbatore..q: Why does my Acer LED TV have clear audio but a completely dark screen in Coimbatore?
tv/acer-tv-repair-service-in-coimbatore..a: On Acer televisions, this symptom indicates failure of the LED backlight diode string. The mainboard and sound amplifier continue working, but the display lacks illumination. Replacing the matched aluminum-core LED backlight strips costs approximately ₹1,000–₹3,000+ depending on screen size.
